book.name: 2 KORIN
book.title: 2 KORIN Pol ok mega derewa Korin nagirewa inamup sen

content: Pol, nop mega uiwa gapan tantan noa wan
God nop mega gapan anega sean,

content.text: Apan da evene enu yave wat anupi,
koewa tani yao anune nagire dere o yampo den yone wap.

content: Ap umap sia, ne den wam koni yampoa aigap sia daio e inayap ongepen taivin.

Ne daio nega derewa inayap tauana gapan, orup upi koewa tane go koewa muga ae ya veane menan tagigire diamon. Endi ne wandap wanik angina gapan, ne nop mame menan tagigit aigap sia anega diaivin, ne evi tauapena gapan koewa taiana nagirewa e agun anun kaimakaet diain.
Keriso amun neneni gapan waingina tavewa ame e yawai, iwa Keriso ne gamunape e inayap tapi me aro mega aigap iragen nimakayap venaseta. Keriso nutu uon ya wandia.

Ame tave di, Keriso nutu uoni gapan oma korosi gagap to endawane, go God amun mega gapan endi inakaen kabani wandia. Ap mini nu Keriso nave taintoni nagirewa den nutunu uon go God amun nuneni gapan enan nao taivinait.

Ek ingane geanguan tan ae yawan, e gaset Iesu anu tumaseana, om ap di waniasi go? Ap menan ek tayao wareyao tan. Ap gapan Iesu e nimakayap amba potayap wandini anuiwanin go uon? Uon wanewa, ame anu tumat ega gase wakaumean.
Go nu ap ya wakaumetoni menan iman yao matakam nimanai.

E inak koewa ya tapen menan nu God inap mup waivin. Nu mup ap tatoni iwa mega ame nu Iesu watu enamot nagirewa wa ewamopen menan uon go e negin tamana aisepen menan. E negin tamana ya aisenewa gapan ne tauapena go kaimakaet da ya diaepena, menan upi anega wapiwa, “Pol evene wai den mu Iesu watu enamot mega da uon, iwa mu kwekwera,” ap wapiwa, ame dim da uon, iwa inak bawarewa ame e ek inak ega wat tamanamepen.
Menan gueguewa ame e asigiap, nu God No Oise Kakaewa tobot wabot tapen menan umanup uon go senare tau aepen menan taivin.
Ap menan nu nutun ae bigarepi wamewa, e aroe den wainiene menan atonaya wait. Go e aigap aigap tamana taiwaniampen menan mupewa God inap waivin.

Iwa ap me menan ne ok ma mawayap siangin, ame menan ne amena tauapenawa amun nega waran taina gapan kaimakaet ya diain. Amun ame inak ega kakaewa ao tu dorapen menan Ayop neneni, e inak ega ae antapenapen menan uon.

Kaewa kaewa, tatan gwanin, gaun inayap waiangin, aton tan. Wainien nao ega kakaewa ta oitamepen menan taiwanian, anenen tat diaena nopewa di waran taiwanian, imuya potaya daiton tap nonup gapan wanien. Amba God baigan megawa ge nonup megawa inayap wande aiwandata.
Gaun gare gare taiwanian. God waenapan mega mapa iragi gaun inayap waiwanum.
Ayop Iesu Keriso garaet wat aipakam imaep. God enan anu gurep. Guewa Woup Seniwa e iravi inayap tobore wande aiwandan.
